Cartilaginous_Dorsal_Fins.description: Emblazoned with sleek, flexible cartilage, these dorsal fins slice through the murky depths, enhancing the wearer's agility and speed by 60%, as they hunt with the instinctual savagery of a shark, ready to unleash devastating skills like Blood Frenzy and Breach.

Horizontal_Tail_Fluke.description: Enveloped in the depths of the ocean, the Horizontal_Tail_Fluke is a powerful appendage that propels its whale-like form with unmatched grace and strength, granting the creature the ability to breach the surface with explosive force and delve into the abyssal depths with ease, enhancing its speed in aquatic environments by a formidable fifty percent.

Continuous_Ribbon_Fin.description: The continuous ribbon fin is a slender, undulating appendage that grants unparalleled agility and speed in water, allowing the wielder to slither through the tightest crevices and reverse direction with supernatural ease, while also providing an innate skill to blend into underwater environments and hide from prying eyes.
